# Get-ZbxActiveAgentStatus

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the running active agent sessions.

## SYNTAX

```
Get-ZbxActiveAgentStatus [[-Name] <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Get-ZbxActiveAgentStatus cmdlet writes the active agent sessions running in this runspace, or the one named in -Name: each with its name, the host it reports as, when it started, and AgentStatus, the counts of values delivered and rejected and the time of its last exchange with the server. It reads only the runspace's own sessions and sends nothing. Start-ZbxActiveAgent starts a session and Stop-ZbxActiveAgent ends it.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: List the running active agents

```powershell
Get-ZbxActiveAgentStatus | Select-Object Name, Kind, Started
```

Every active agent session of this runspace.

### Example 2: Check what an agent has delivered

```powershell
(Get-ZbxActiveAgentStatus -Name 'web-agent').AgentStatus
```

AgentStatus counts what the server accepted and refused.

## PARAMETERS

### -Name

The session's name; every running active-agent session when omitted.
